顾承安站在一楼客厅的落地窗旁边，看了看手机，

显示时间，凌晨两点十七分。

黎志义蜷缩着躺在沙发上，脑袋歪着，不知道是吓晕了还是累晕了，发出轻微的鼾声，顾承安瞥了他一眼，懒得理会。

反正跑不了。

他走到厨房转了一圈，打开冰箱翻了翻。黎志义这冰箱倒是挺讲究，有机牛奶、进口矿泉水、还有几盒日文的零食。

顾承安拿了瓶矿泉水，拧开灌了两口。

别墅里安静得不像话。那六个人还躺着，药效还没过，暂时还醒不了。

大约二十多分钟后，马路上传来轻微的引擎声。

从东面缓缓靠近别墅方向。

顾承安放下矿泉水瓶，走到玄关处的控制面板，把庭院的部分灯和大厅的主灯依次打开。

他推开庭院的侧门，迈步走到院子中央，双手自然垂在身侧，站定。

那两辆车在距别墅大门约三十米的地方停了下来，车门打开的声音几乎听不见，但顾承安能感觉到至少下来了六个人。

脚步声从围墙外绕过来，步伐轻快。

没有人直接推门进来。

他们贴着别墅大门两侧的墙壁散开，几道黑影压低身形，动作训练有素。其中一人侧身靠在门柱后面，小心地把脑袋探了出来，只露出半张脸和一只眼。

那只眼和顾承安对上了。

顾承安没动，淡然道：“临时编码KO541上菜。”

对面那人缩回去了。

沉默了几秒钟。

然后那人重新探出头，低声回了一串字符：“核验通过，临时编码GRD0918润”

顾承安掏出保密手机，调出此前接收到的验证序列，对上了。

他点了点头。

大门推开，走进来五个人。打头的是个中等身材的男人，三十五六岁左右，面部表情可以用四个字概括——全程面瘫。

门口还留了两人。

顾承安在心里给对面带队的人打了个标签：专业，真专业。

不像电影里那种踹门进来“兄弟辛苦了”的桥段。

现实中的对接就是这样——冷、快、没有一句废话。

双方没有自我介绍，没有握手，没有寒暄。带队的人走到顾承安面前三米处站定，目光扫了一圈庭院和大厅内部，然后看向顾承安。

意思很明确：说吧。

顾承安也不废话。

Gu Chengan stood next to the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room on the first floor and looked at his phone.

The time is displayed, two seventeen in the morning.

Li Zhiyi was curled up on the sofa with his head tilted. He was snoring slightly, whether from shock or exhaustion. Gu Chengan glanced at him and was too lazy to pay attention.

I can't run away anyway.

He walked to the kitchen and walked around, opened the refrigerator and rummaged through it.Li Zhiyi's refrigerator is quite particular, with organic milk, imported mineral water, and several boxes of Japanese snacks.

Gu Chengan took a bottle of mineral water, opened it and took two sips.

It was eerily quiet in the villa.Those six people are still lying down. The effects of the medicine have not yet worn off and they cannot wake up yet.

About twenty minutes later, a slight engine sound came from the road.

Slowly approach the villa from the east.

Gu Chengan put down the mineral water bottle, walked to the control panel at the entrance, and turned on some of the lights in the courtyard and the main lights in the hall.

He pushed open the side door of the courtyard, walked to the center of the courtyard, and stood still with his hands naturally hanging by his sides.

The two cars stopped about thirty meters away from the villa gate. The sound of the car doors opening was almost inaudible, but Gu Chengan could feel that at least six people got out.

Footsteps came around the wall, the steps were brisk.

No one just pushed the door open and came in.

They spread out against the walls on both sides of the villa's door. Several black figures lowered their figures and made well-trained movements.One of them leaned sideways behind the doorpost and carefully poked his head out, revealing only half of his face and one eye.

That eye met Gu Chengan's.

Gu Chengan did not move and said calmly: "Temporary code KO541 is served."

The man opposite shrank back.

There was silence for a few seconds.

Then the man stuck his head out again and whispered back a string of characters: "Verification passed, temporary code GRD0918 Run"

Gu Chengan took out his confidential mobile phone, called up the verification sequence he had received before, and matched it.

He nodded.

The door opened and five people walked in.The leader was a man of medium build, about thirty-five or six years old, and his facial expression could be summed up in four words—complete facial paralysis.

There were two people left at the door.

Gu Chengan mentally labeled the person leading the team across from him: professional, really professional.

It's not like the scene in the movie where you kick in the door and say "Thank you, brother".

This is how docking works in reality—cold, fast, and without a word of nonsense.

There was no self-introduction, no handshakes, no pleasantries.The person leading the team walked to a stand three meters in front of Gu Chengan, glanced around the courtyard and inside the hall, and then looked at Gu Chengan.

The meaning is clear: speak up.

Gu Chengan didn't talk nonsense either.
